subject: Literature in English
sourceFile: Arts & Humanities -- LITERATURE IN ENGLISH.txt (WAEC harmonised list of texts 2026-2030) + WASSCE Literature in English scheme of examination
examFormat: Three papers, all compulsory; Papers 1 and 2 are taken at one sitting. Paper 1 (1 hour, 50 marks): 50 multiple-choice questions — 20 on general knowledge of literature, 5 on one unseen prose passage (about 120–150 words), 5 on one unseen poem and 20 context questions on the prescribed Shakespearean text. Paper 2 (1 hour 15 minutes, 50 marks): essays — Section A African prose, Section B non-African prose, two questions on each prescribed novel; answer one from each section. Paper 3 (2 hours 30 minutes, 50 marks): Section A African drama, B non-African drama, C African poetry, D non-African poetry, two questions on each prescribed text; answer one from each section (four in all).
excluded: Full texts of the prescribed poems (copyright; students read them in their anthologies). Set texts change with each WAEC list: these are for 2026–2030.
